accepted.sentence: In crowded downtown districts, marked lanes give commuters a predictable route separated from faster motor traffic.
At public rental docks, users unlock shared machines for short trips and return them at another station.
On suburban rail journeys, compact folding models can be carried aboard where transit rules permit.
In velodromes, racers circle steeply banked wooden tracks on machines designed for smooth, uninterrupted laps.
On forest trails, sturdy suspension helps riders cross roots, loose stones, and ruts with better control.
During indoor winter training, a rear wheel can sit in a resistance trainer while the rider pedals in place.
In food-delivery work, insulated boxes secured behind the seat carry orders through neighborhood streets.
In snowy regions, studded tires can improve grip on icy paths, although cautious riding remains essential.
